prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: low-speed head-on collision in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1025; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative. On arrival at the scene in Pearland, Texas, I observed two vehicles with front-end damage in the southbound lane near the intersection. Driver 1 was seated in the driver's seat of the first vehicle, a gray sedan, and reported that the other vehicle crossed into the lane of travel, resulting in a low-speed head-on collision. Driver 1 stated that they struck their head against the steering wheel and experienced dizziness, confusion, and a headache immediately afterward. Driver 1 reported symptoms consistent with a concussion and was transported by EMS for evaluation. Driver 2, operating a blue SUV, stated that they had braked before impact and did not see Driver 1 until the moment of collision. Passenger, seated in the rear of the SUV, reported no injury. Both vehicles were drivable with assistance and were moved to the shoulder. Weather was clear and the roadway was dry. No citations were issued at the scene pending further investigation.
